pinned_model.name: PARM
pinned_model.aggregation: equal mean of 5 official HEK293 folds
pinned_model.input_encoding: official bare FASTA; official central zero-pad to L_max=600; filter_size=125; type_loss=poisson

input_construction.rule: variable insert = design_seq[15:len-15]; constant flanks stripped; variant centered
input_construction.orientation: single author-supplied sequence only; source orientation field UNKNOWN; no outcome-chosen RC

source_corroboration_preflight.source: PMC13060879 Europe PMC full XML (local copy)
quotes: MAPT Promoter Mutagenesis: 219 bp oligos were designed for a 2,000 bp region surrounding and including the promoter and ordered from Twist Biosciences.
For every base in this region, an oligo was designed where the reference sequence is centered on the position of interest, plus 3 alternate-base oligos and a centered 5 bp deletion.
For SNVs, 219 bp oligos were designed with the variant centered for both the reference sequence and the alternate allele.
The variant sequences were the length of 219 or 218 bp minus the number of bases being deleted.
Oligos were inserted into pLS-SceI following the published protocol.
source_corroboration_preflight.empirical: 30 constant columns across the author 2000 reference oligos (15+15 flank); SAT SNV ref-vs-alt single-base mismatch at design offset 124; KV SNV alt-vs-ref mismatch at design offset 125 with alt base equal to header alt allele.
source_corroboration_preflight.distinction: 249 bp synthesized design = 15+15 constant flank + 219 bp measured variable insert; the measured variable insert is scored; exact cloning/vector role beyond pLS-SceI is UNKNOWN (a fixed vector does NOT prove non-autonomy).

KV_SNV_HEK293FT.note: 2kb-gap clusters are EXPLORATORY components, not verified independent CRE families

metric_plan.model_output: per-sequence raw PARM HEK293 score; equal mean of 5 official HEK293 folds
metric_plan.predicted_effect_d: mean_score(alt_insert) - mean_score(ref_insert); fixed before any label
metric_plan.true_effect: author bcalm logFC (variant vs reference control); log base NOT assumed

KV_SNV.pooled_spearman: Spearman(d, logFC); NaN-label rows excluded from numeric metric after row-count disclosure
KV_SNV.group_bootstrap: paired group bootstrap 2000 with multiplicity retained, only if >=30 effective groups and deltaGC baseline finite; else descriptive

secondary.SAT_allrows_p_and_abs_effect_strata: descriptive interpretation only; never replaces primary

baselines_zero_fit.delta_gc_fraction: GC(alt_insert) - GC(ref_insert) on the SAME paired inserts
baselines_zero_fit.direction_baselines: fixed always-positive and always-negative sign rules; model strict sign accuracy with predicted ties counted wrong; true-zero effects excluded from sign denominator, all other finite effects retained

warrants_separate_variant_path_if: macro strict sign accuracy > both fixed sign baselines

license: PARM local academic evaluation only; weights/source NOT redistributed.
gpu: none in this step (CPU assembly only)
